Calls for India-Pakistan dialogue and peace in Jammu and Kashmir emerge

Political figures and citizens have called for a resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan to resolve issues concerning Jammu and Kashmir. Suggestions include transforming the region into a bridge for peace and strengthening ties with neighboring countries. These calls come amidst differing perspectives on engagement with Pakistan.
